name: Morristown Municipal Airport

runway.v: two runways; the longer, 5/23, is 5,998 ft x 150 ft (about 1,828 m)

customs.v: CBP user-fee facility; normal hours Monday to Friday 10:00-18:00 local (from 12 Jan 2026); outside these hours on request with overtime fee, ask before 12:00 the same weekday, or by 12:00 Friday for weekends
customs.quote: New Hours effective Jan. 12, 2026: 10:00 AM – 6:00 PM | Monday through Friday

noise.v: voluntary noise abatement procedures; no closed traffic or practice instrument approaches 22:00-08:30 local; runway 13 only for operational necessity
noise.quote: No closed traffic operations on any runway or practice instrument approaches between the hours of 2200L to 0830L.

notes: Airport operator DM Airports, Ltd. The CBP fact sheet of 17 Sep 2024 (M-F 08:00-16:00) is superseded by the airport's own customs page (new hours from 12 Jan 2026). Current Chart Supplement (29 Oct 2026) could not be opened; no curfew or airport hours found in an official source read. FAA identifier MMU.
